title: Extending one abstract class while implementing multiple interfaces
answer: Yes. A Java class may extend at most one class, including one abstract class, and implement multiple interfaces at the same time. The superclass supplies the single implementation and state inheritance chain, while interfaces add multiple contracts. The class must implement any abstract obligations that remain unresolved across all of those parents.
